query:
CREATE TABLE workstations (
  id INT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY,
  code VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL UNIQUE,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  lineId INT,
  workshopId INT,
  factoryId INT,
  processType ENUM('SMT', 'DIP', 'ASSEMBLY', 'TESTING', 'PACKAGING', 'OTHER') DEFAULT 'OTHER',
  orderIndex INT DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  isActive BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE NOT NULL,
  createdAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  updatedAt TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
  INDEX idx_workstations_code (code),
  INDEX idx_workstations_line (lineId),
  INDEX idx_workstations_workshop (workshopId),
  INDEX idx_workstations_factory (factoryId)
);
